fields.label: Purpose
fields.value: Detect modification or substitution of downloaded content.

fields.label: Steps
value: Obtain the expected digest from an authenticated/trusted source.
Compute the digest of the received file with a suitable modern algorithm.
Compare values using the correct algorithm and encoding.
If a mismatch occurs, reject or investigate the file; if it matches, interpret the result only within the trust model.

fields.label: Caveats
value: A digest posted beside a file on the same unauthenticated channel may be replaced together with the file.
A matching hash does not prove that software is benign or that the publisher is trustworthy.

fields.label: Purpose
fields.value: Authenticate messages using a shared secret and a standardized keyed construction.

fields.label: Steps
value: Agree on a secure hash and shared secret key.
Compute the HMAC over the canonical message representation.
Transmit the message and authentication tag.
Receiver recomputes the HMAC and compares tags using an appropriate constant-time comparison.

fields.label: Caveats
value: Do not substitute naive hash(secret || message) constructions for HMAC.
Key management and message canonicalization remain important.

fields.label: Purpose
fields.value: Commit to a large data set and verify components using a root digest and authentication path.

fields.label: Steps
value: Hash each leaf using an unambiguous encoding.
Hash internal nodes from their child hashes.
Publish or authenticate the root digest.
Verify a selected leaf by recomputing its path to the root.

fields.label: Caveats
value: Tree layout, leaf/node domain separation, and encoding must be specified to avoid ambiguity.

fields.label: Purpose
fields.value: Make request creation moderately costly while allowing cheap validation.

fields.label: Steps
value: Define a target predicate over a hash output.
Vary a nonce or candidate header and compute hashes until the predicate passes.
Verifier performs one or a small number of hash computations and checks the predicate.

fields.label: Caveats
value: Difficulty must be calibrated; proof of work does not itself establish the truth or legitimacy of the submitted content.

fields.label: Purpose
fields.value: Detect modification or substitution of downloaded content.

fields.label: Steps
value: Obtain the expected digest from an authenticated/trusted source.
Compute the digest of the received file with a suitable modern algorithm.
Compare values using the correct algorithm and encoding.
If a mismatch occurs, reject or investigate the file; if it matches, interpret the result only within the trust model.

fields.label: Caveats
value: A digest posted beside a file on the same unauthenticated channel may be replaced together with the file.
A matching hash does not prove that software is benign or that the publisher is trustworthy.

Compute the HMAC over the canonical message representation.
Transmit the message and authentication tag.
Receiver recomputes the HMAC and compares tags using an appropriate constant-time comparison.

fields.label: Caveats
value: Do not substitute naive hash(secret || message) constructions for HMAC.
Key management and message canonicalization remain important.

fields.label: Purpose
fields.value: Address and deduplicate objects based on content.

fields.label: Steps
value: Select a collision-resistant hash and a canonical byte representation.
Hash the content to derive a content address.
Store the object and index its address to physical storage.
On retrieval, recompute the hash to verify content integrity.

fields.label: Caveats
value: Collision handling and algorithm migration should be part of the design.
The content address is not automatically a claim of publisher authenticity.

fields.label: Purpose
fields.value: Detect modification or substitution of downloaded content.

fields.label: Steps
value: Obtain the expected digest from an authenticated/trusted source.
Compute the digest of the received file with a suitable modern algorithm.
Compare values using the correct algorithm and encoding.
If a mismatch occurs, reject or investigate the file; if it matches, interpret the result only within the trust model.

fields.label: Caveats
value: A digest posted beside a file on the same unauthenticated channel may be replaced together with the file.
A matching hash does not prove that software is benign or that the publisher is trustworthy.
